evidenceBasis: Completed bounded official-source review of historical production, with consolidation resolutions; not actual older-cluster integration.
currentSourceApplicability: Requires reassessment after production layout changes.

findings.change: PV zone/region metadata labels constrain VolumeZone scheduling independently of spec.nodeAffinity; Kubernetes1.29 adds missing-beta-node-key fallback to the corresponding GA key.
findings.toolImpact: checkScheduling currently appends only PV.spec.nodeAffinity. It can credit spare capacity on a node outside a label-constrained PV zone and pass preflight before source retirement. This is a baseline gap exposed by the1.29 note, not a newly removed API.
findings.requiredAction: Parent consolidated implementation pass must add conservative manual refusal for these labels, or verified version-aware matching. Do not mark resolved in this reviewer snapshot.
findings.residualScope: Known keys: failure-domain.beta.kubernetes.io/zone, failure-domain.beta.kubernetes.io/region, topology.kubernetes.io/zone, topology.kubernetes.io/region. Terms are ANDed, allowed values ORed.1.27 requires exact node keys;1.29 falls back only when a beta node key is absent. Nodes with no topology keys skip this scheduler plugin. Conservative refusal avoids guessing patch/plugin semantics.

findings.change: Kubernetes1.28 fixes PriorityClass-scoped quota usage aggregation; backport117825 delivered the fix in1.27.2.
findings.toolImpact: quotaApplies uses nonempty priorityClassName for Exists, its inverse for DoesNotExist, and explicit In/NotIn values. Those semantics match the fixed server. The original bug was missing Exists in spec.scopes usage-stat evaluation, not a general difference in explicit Exists/DoesNotExist matching. Official OpenShift4.14.0 starts with Kubernetes1.27.6, beyond the upstream fix.
findings.requiredAction: No additional production change identified for this named change.
findings.residualScope: The fix is present before the supported OpenShift floor. This does not prove all server quota counters or concurrent admission remain synchronized.

findings.change: The webhook-authorizer SAR default for an omitted resourceAttributes.version changes to wildcard in1.28.
findings.toolImpact: Runner.access now explicitly supplies the version used by each actual endpoint: v1, autoscaling/v2, or optional admin-policy/v1alpha1; required-SCC LocalSAR already uses v1. Fix0dcf787 prevents version-sensitive authorizers from falsely refusing an allowed operation.
findings.requiredAction: No additional production change identified for this named change.
findings.residualScope: Actual API operations still enforce authorization; local profiles do not constitute an older-server/custom-webhook integration test.

findings.change: New Pod/init/affinity/security fields and admission-policy capabilities may exist without changing the stable API version.
findings.toolImpact: validateBaseline checks raw source/admission objects against the1.27 catalog before typed conversion; unsupported post-floor semantics require review. Deployment/ReplicaSet/HPA raw guards detect unfamiliar response fields. Strict server dry runs of source retirement, destination activation and actual proposed Pod precede source mutation.
findings.requiredAction: No additional production change identified for this named change.
findings.residualScope: Admission outcomes remain controller/name/identity specific; dry run is point-in-time evidence and cannot certify every third-party webhook.

findings.change: Restartable init sidecars are introduced in1.28 and enabled by default as beta in1.29, with HPA resource calculation and termination-order fixes.
findings.toolImpact: The post-floor init-container restartPolicy is not silently dropped: source/admitted sidecars require manual migration. podResources and observed allocation accounting include sidecar demand for other existing Pods.
findings.requiredAction: No additional production change identified for this named change.
findings.residualScope: No claim of automatic native-sidecar conversion or old-server native-sidecar runtime qualification.

findings.change: Scheduler hint/plugin interfaces, resource claims, CPU Manager/cgroup behavior and node-availability fixes change independently of Pod API serving.
findings.toolImpact: Converter is not a scheduler plugin and imports no scheduling framework. checkScheduling rejects custom schedulers, hard inter-Pod affinity/spread, gates and dynamic claims; nodeSelector/nodeName/taints/capacity are evaluated against observed admitted Pod and current allocations. It does not reserve capacity or simulate NUMA, devices or custom plugins.
findings.requiredAction: Require healthy, appropriately patched nodes and workload-specific hardware/runtime validation; retain explicit warning that capacity assessment is not reservation.
findings.residualScope: Automatic mode does not promise scheduler/plugin equivalence or continued node health.4.16 exclusive-CPU replacement startup note is handled by complete old-Pod termination in exclusive cutover, but CPU Manager defects remain a platform prerequisite.

findings.change: PDB draining/preemption fixes, terminating endpoint routing, Service finalizer/address handling and cloud load-balancer bugs affect controllers.
findings.toolImpact: Production uses stable policy/v1 PDB selectors and synchronized disruptionsAllowed to assess planned scaling; it does not call eviction/drain, create Services, change finalizers, or delete/reallocate Service addresses. Existing Service selectors and actual endpoint Pod identities are checked; route/HTTP validation remains runtime evidence.
findings.requiredAction: No additional production change identified for this named change.
findings.residualScope: No zero-downtime guarantee is derived from API acceptance; patched CNI/load balancer and real health checks remain prerequisites.

findings.change: Installer, operator, console, monitoring, cluster-upgrade and scheduler metric changes are distinct from converter APIs.
findings.toolImpact: Neither production inventory nor qualification creates machines, configures control planes, installs storage/network operators, manages OLM Bundle APIs or scrapes scheduler metrics. HPA console controls, image-output UI links and web-console duplicate imagePullSecrets fixes do not change the direct JSON REST migration protocol.
findings.requiredAction: No additional production change identified for this named change.
findings.residualScope: A healthy installed cluster is still required; irrelevant interfaces are not a general claim that all platform defects cannot affect workloads.

findings.change: Cluster AdminNetworkPolicy/BaselineAdminNetworkPolicy availability expands from Technology Preview to generally available in4.16.
findings.toolImpact: Optional capability discovery plus selector assessment in93efcf3 checks admin-policy subjects/peers as well as namespace NetworkPolicies before source retirement.132542b requires manual review for selectors depending on the Deployment-generated future pod-template-hash label. Denied or unassessed capabilities cannot be treated as policy absence.
findings.requiredAction: No additional production change identified for this named change.
findings.residualScope: Selector equivalence is not complete network priority/traffic simulation. Actual policy live evidence stays tied to its recorded4.21 binary.

findings.change: DeploymentConfigs remain deprecated and capability dependent; removed APIs do not intersect production or fixture inventory.
findings.toolImpact: Live DC discovery must succeed, with unavailable capability distinguished from denial/expiry. Offline exported-input conversion remains possible and cannot execute an incomplete plan.1.29 flowcontrol/v1beta2 and ClusterCIDR removal, scheduler component-config removals and RukPak Bundle removal are outside both inventories.
findings.requiredAction: Do not infer that a disabled DeploymentConfig or Build capability can be restored by the converter.
findings.residualScope: Review evidence; no older-cluster integration result.

findings.change: Automatic SA secret creation changes; legacy token cleanup and bound image-pull token refresh replace implicit long-lived Secret dependencies.
findings.toolImpact: Runner.connect loads kubeconfig and treats bearer tokens as opaque. Converter preserves workload SA/projection/imagePullSecrets and does not select the first generated SA Secret. Test drivers explicitly use TokenRequest. Expired credentials or unavailable image credentials fail visibly; the converter does not re-enable old tokens.
findings.requiredAction: Use valid credentials and working image-pull configuration. Build/new-app fixtures additionally require enabled Build/ImageRegistry capabilities.
findings.residualScope: Review evidence; no older-cluster integration result.

findings.change: RWOP/SELinux mount optimizations, retroactive StorageClass assignment, CSI migration, detachment and driver-specific topology requirements affect runtime storage.
findings.toolImpact: Production reads existing Bound claims and backing PVs, preserves volume/security configuration, and does not provision/resize/delete storage or edit CSIDriver/StorageClass. Ephemeral claim provisioning is manual. CephFS/RBD and gitRepo require replacements through existing guards. API success alone cannot prove mount, relabel, attachment-slot or node-failure behavior.
findings.requiredAction: Require reviewed existing CSI storage and a workload-specific mount/data check; vSphere tags and driver prerequisites must be correct. A single regular-PVC test does not qualify every driver, RWOP or SELinux mode.
findings.residualScope: Separate actionable PV metadata-topology gap is STORAGE-PV-TOPOLOGY-LABELS. Driver attachment limits/mounting remain explicitly unsimulated.

findings.change: Build-controller image-pull secret lookup, cloud registry auth, disconnected imports and mirror/TLS fixes affect image availability.
findings.toolImpact: Production preserves image references and emits image.openshift.io/triggers; it neither performs builds nor imports ImageStreamTags. Real new-app/rebuild/trigger qualification additionally exercises build/image controllers, registry credentials and disconnected-mirror configuration; those must be assessed separately from production RBAC.
findings.requiredAction: Do not rely on implicit general-purpose SA Secret linking for builds. Preserve explicit imagePullSecrets; require functioning imports/builds before migration.
findings.residualScope: Review evidence; no older-cluster integration result.

findings.change: Patch notes cover SA mountable-secret envFrom enforcement, Windows security defects, HTTP/2 protections, duplicate-keyed-list/Pod-GC regressions and scheduler crashes.
findings.toolImpact: CVE-2024-3177 can cause stricter Pod admission for envFrom; the same source workload can be rejected by corrected policy, so live preflight must validate it before source changes. Windows node/log/storage vulnerabilities, CNI/CSI runtime failures and server transport limits are platform patch responsibilities. Converter does not call node logs/query or manage runtime binaries. Dependency scanner results remain separate evidence.
findings.requiredAction: Use a maintained vendor-patched release and validate corrected Pod admission. Do not derive an OpenShift fix patch solely from an upstream Kubernetes version because downstream backports differ.
findings.residualScope: This is a bounded compatibility/security-interface assessment of named changelog advisories, not an exhaustive audit of every cluster dependency, third-party add-on or later advisory.

findings.change: NetworkPolicy.status is removed, PVC resize status changes, PV transition timestamp is added, and hostNetwork hostPort defaults move from templates to actual Pods.
findings.toolImpact: The tool uses NetworkPolicy.spec only, reads Bound claim/reference/topology rather than resizeStatus, and does not resize/delete claims. Host namespace workloads already require manual placement review; admitted Pod validation observes actual Pod defaults independently of Deployment templates.
findings.requiredAction: No additional production change identified for this named change.
findings.residualScope: Review evidence; no older-cluster integration result.

findings.change: OCPBUGS11933 describes a later informative OVN annotation update triggering SCC re-admission under a more privileged actor; primary issue lists4.16.0 as fixVersion.
findings.toolImpact: SCC subject/required-policy authorization and raw Pod dry run validate creation but cannot prove later CNI mutation behavior on an unfixed server. Converter does not update Pod annotations itself; corrected server behavior is external. Do not call this issue fixed by converter guards or assume a4.15 backport from the4.16 note.
findings.requiredAction: For affected/unfixed clusters, require operator review of actual Pod SCC/security behavior and server patch state; broad4.15 assumptions must preserve this runtime prerequisite.
findings.residualScope: Primary fix ignores unchanged-spec updates limited to OVN k8s.ovn.org/pod-networks annotation/GC metadata, narrower than a general metadata bypass.

historicalSnapshots: Exact snapshots and source-bound resolution overlays require the external evidence bundle.
